# Erdos.p853 — Erdős problem 853

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/853
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/853.lean`, theorem `erdos_853.parts.i`, AMS 11).

Let $d_n = p_{n+1} - p_n$, where $p_n$ is the $n$th prime. Let $r(x)$ be the smallest even
integer $t$ such that $d_n = t$ has no solutions for $n \le x$.

Is it true that $r(x) \to \infty$?
